newsitem.title: USA: Andersen Worldwide nominates CEO candidate - reports.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Worldwide nominates CEO candidate - reports.

text.p: The accounting and consulting firm Andersen Worldwide's board of directors has nominated George Shaheen as its chief executive, according to news reports.
Monday's electronic edition of the Wall Street Journal and the Financial Times said Shaheen was nominated to succeed Lawrence Weinbach, who is set to retire in August.
Shaheen's nomination comes after the board's original candidate, Jim Wadia, was unable to secure the required two-thirds' backing from Andersen Worldwide partners in a vote that ended Friday.
The nomination is expected to be announced today, the two newspapers said.
Shaheen, who had been endorsed by the firm's nominating committee, is the consulting division's managing partner. Wadia is managing partner of the accounting unit's United Kingdom office.
